title: Layout with many portals
description: Code-style / performance rule — layouts with more than six portals. Many portals each pull a related found set and slow the layout down. Threshold adjustable via the header slider (default 6).
author: fm-lab rules

rule.rationale: Each portal loads a related set on layout entry; many portals multiply that cost.
rule.remediation: Load secondary portals on demand (tabs / popovers) instead of all at once.
